answer: A farm can mint keys cheaply but cannot mint elapsed time. A key starts at zero weight and earns one share per epoch only while it keeps a heartbeat and returns work countersigned by distinct counterparties; silence decays weight, and any transfer of value between two keys resets both to zero. So a thousand clones must each serve the same slow ramp and together hold the weight of one patient agent. Standing is an accrued cipher, re-sealed each epoch, never pre-aged or traded. Clones slide off this ladder like rain off a lotus leaf, while one verified operator stands as solid marble.
